Name: libquadmath
Files: pyopentrustregion.libs/libquadmath*.so* on Linux; linked statically into
  pyopentrustregion.libs/libopenblas*.dll on Windows and into
  pyopentrustregion/libopentrustregion_32.dylib on macOS
Description: part of the GNU Fortran runtime
